bbs.config.appearance.click_sound-commen: By enabling this option, button clicks will play BBS Studio's custom clicking sound effect
bbs.config.appearance.force_qwerty-comme: For key codes display, force displaying of QWERTY layout instead of currently used layout (like AZERTY, QWERTZ or ЙЦУКЕ)
bbs.config.appearance.fov-comment: This option controls FOV for camera in world menu and animation panel
bbs.config.performance.freeze_models-com: When enabled, models in form picker won't follow the mouse
bbs.config.performance.title: Performance
bbs.config.performance.tooltip: Everything that trades work for frames: previews, caches, translucency and the performance counters
bbs.config.performance.list_model_previe: When enabled, entries in the replay, selector and form part lists render a small 3D preview of their model. Turn it off to declutter the lists or save performance.
bbs.config.performance.preview_refresh_b: Form pictures in lists and palettes are kept as textures and re-rendered in rotation, this many per frame; an edited form always re-renders at once. 0 renders every picture live every frame (the old behaviour).
bbs.config.appearance.morphing_focus_sea: When enabled, the form search field is focused automatically when you open the morphing menu
bbs.ui.textures.save_dialog.name: File name...
bbs.ui.textures.save_tooltip: Save as... (Shift — save in place, same as Ctrl+S)
bbs.ui.textures.save_dialog.pick_folder: Pick a folder in your assets
bbs.ui.textures.browser.everywhere: Search in all folders, not only the current one
bbs.ui.textures.browser.new_texture-desc: A blank transparent texture is created in the current folder and opened in the editor.
bbs.ui.textures.browser.new_texture.name: Name...
bbs.ui.textures.browser.sort.name: Name
bbs.ui.textures.browser.new_folder-descr: Name of the folder to create in the current one:
bbs.ui.textures.browser.rename-descripti: New name (the .mcmeta of an animated texture is renamed along):
bbs.ui.textures.browser.combine-descript: %s textures, from %s to %s, become the frames of one animated texture, in the order they are shown in:
bbs.ui.textures.browser.combine.name: Name...
bbs.ui.textures.browser.combine.frametim: How many ticks one frame lasts
bbs.ui.textures.browser.combine.failed: Couldn't combine the textures: a file with that name may already be there
bbs.ui.textures.browser.combine.no_folde: There is nowhere to put the animation: open the folder it should be saved into
bbs.ui.textures.browser.read_only: This texture is built into the mod. Copy it into your assets to change it.
bbs.config.appearance.title: Appearance
bbs.config.appearance.tooltip: General options regarding the appearance of GUIs and the framework
bbs.config.personalization.title: Personalization
bbs.config.transformation.title: Transformation
bbs.config.transformation.tooltip: Settings for axes and gizmos used for translation, rotation and scaling
bbs.config.transformation.gizmos-comment: Whether grab-able axes elements for translation, scale and rotation are enabled
bbs.config.transformation.axes_scale-com: Determines the size of axes, if the axes are too big, you can adjust to your liking
bbs.config.transformation.axes_thickness: Thickness of the axis lines (gizmo and world axes)
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_plane_si: How big the gizmo's two-axis planes are. They grow outwards from the same starting point, so a bigger plane is easier to grab without moving away from the origin
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_keep_scr: When enabled, the gizmo keeps roughly the same on-screen size as the camera distance changes. Markers and motion paths keep their fixed size either way
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_show_tra: Whether the gizmo shows its movement elements: the axis bars, the two-axis planes and the white centre cube that drags in the screen plane
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_show_sca: Whether the gizmo shows its scale elements: the cubes at the ends of the axes, and the centre cube for uniform scale when movement is hidden
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_show_rot: Whether the gizmo shows the three axis rotation rings. With them hidden the movement and scale elements grow back to full size, since there is nothing left to nest inside
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_show_vie: Whether the gizmo shows the outer camera-facing ring, which turns the object around the view direction
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_show_sph: Whether the gizmo shows the free-rotation sphere in the middle. Hiding it only takes it away from the mouse — the rotation key still walks through it
bbs.config.transformation.rotate_3d_sphe: Trackball follows cursor motion (roll with the mouse wheel), arcball grabs the point under the cursor and rolls when dragged around the sphere's outside
bbs.config.transformation.hide_inactive_: When enabled, grabbing a gizmo handle hides all the other handles for the duration of the drag, leaving only the one being transformed; when disabled, the gizmo never hides anything
bbs.config.transformation.pose_show_disa: When enabled, the model's factory-disabled bones (such as eyes or helper bones) stay selectable in the pose editor, bone lists and viewport instead of being hidden. Reopen the pose editor for it to take effect
bbs.config.transformation.snap_translate: Step (in transform units) the movement snaps to while Ctrl is held during a drag
bbs.config.transformation.snap_rotate-co: Degrees the axis rings snap to while Ctrl is held during a drag; rotation is free otherwise
bbs.config.transformation.snap_scale-com: Step the scale snaps to while Ctrl is held during a drag (Ctrl also scales uniformly)
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_hover_to: How many pixels away from a gizmo handle (line, ring, plane) the cursor still grabs it — the nearest handle within this radius wins. 0 requires an exact hit
bbs.config.transformation.gizmo_opacity-: How opaque the gizmo draws — lower it to see the model through the handles. 1 is fully opaque
bbs.config.transformation.rotate_hotkey_: The order in which repeated presses of the rotation key walk the modes: the view ring, the 3D sphere and the axis rings. Drag the chips to rearrange, right click to reset
bbs.config.transformation.scale_hotkey_o: The order in which repeated presses of the scale key walk the axes. Drag the chips to rearrange, right click to reset
bbs.config.transformation.translate_hotk: The order in which repeated presses of the translate key walk the modes: the screen-plane grab and the axes. Drag the chips to rearrange, right click to reset
bbs.config.transformation.trackball_sens: How fast the free-rotation sphere (trackball) turns per pixel of cursor movement
bbs.config.personalization.primary_color: The color which is used everywhere in the GUI system
bbs.config.personalization.secondary_col: The color of the interface's background surfaces — panels, editors and everything behind them. Every shade of the interface is derived from it.
bbs.config.personalization.stencil_highl: Color used to highlight the bone or replay under the cursor in the viewport. Alpha controls the highlight intensity.
bbs.config.personalization.overlay_backg: How much the interface behind an overlay panel (settings, pickers) is dimmed. Zero leaves it fully visible.
bbs.config.personalization.interface_sha: A shadow along the bottom edge of buttons and toggles, so they sit above the surface behind them.
bbs.config.personalization.interface_hig: A lit edge along the top and left side of buttons and toggles. Off by default: it reads as an embossed look rather than as depth.
bbs.config.personalization.interface_glo: The soft glow around overlay panels, context menus, tooltips, notifications and the current clip in the timeline.
bbs.config.timeline.track_width-comment: The thickness of the keyframe track strip in the dope sheet view
bbs.config.timeline.keyframe_default_sty: Shape, color and fill assigned to newly created keyframes. Existing keyframes are not affected.
bbs.config.timeline.keyframe_preview-com: When enabled, resting the mouse on a keyframe shows a small window with what it holds — the colour, the texture, the posed form, or the value
bbs.config.appearance.trackpad_increment: Enable < and > buttons on the trackpad field (which increment the trackpad value)
bbs.config.appearance.trackpad_scrolling: Enable mouse wheel scrolling on trackpad fields to increment/decrement values
bbs.config.appearance.ui_scale-comment: This option scales the appearance of UI elements and HUD by given factor
bbs.config.appearance.taskbar_side-comme: Which edge of the dashboard the bar with the panel buttons (morphing, films, particle editor and so on) is docked to. It can also be moved by right clicking the bar itself.
bbs.config.appearance.pixel_art_smoothin: At a fractional GUI scale (1.25, 1.5, 1.75) some rows of pixels get doubled and some don't, which makes text and icons look ragged. This smooths the seam between pixels over one screen pixel. Integer scales are left untouched.
bbs.config.appearance.uniform_scale-comm: This option forces uniform scaling for transformation fields when all scale coordinates are same
bbs.config.workspace.clip_auto_name-comm: When on: empty clip title shows type or resource name (e.g. audio filename). When off: only your custom title is shown.
bbs.config.audio.title: Audio
bbs.config.audio.tooltip: Options for in-game audio sync feature
bbs.config.audio.waveform_density-commen: How many pixels of audio waveform should be shown per second
bbs.config.audio.waveform_filename-comme: Whether filename of the played audio in the audio should be shown
bbs.config.audio.waveform_height-comment: Height of an audio bar in pixels
bbs.config.audio.waveform_time-comment: Whether audio track's playback time should be displayed. Keep in mind that audio track's playback time doesn't necessarily represent a scene's current playback time!
bbs.config.audio.waveform_visible_previe: Show the audio waveform in the film preview block
bbs.config.audio.waveform_visible_keyfra: Show the audio waveform in the keyframes block
bbs.config.audio.waveform_preview_combin: When on, the film preview shows one waveform strip with all clips layered in the same scrolling window as separate bars (center playhead, past dimmed) instead of stacking one bar per active clip
bbs.config.audio.waveform_width-comment: Width of an audio bar in floating point percentage (between 0 and 1)
bbs.config.background.color-comment: Background color to be used in every menu. If image is specified, then this will be used as tinting color for background
bbs.config.background.image-comment: Background image to be used in every menu
bbs.config.background.title: Background
bbs.config.background.tooltip: Background options like color and texture to be used
bbs.config.cdn.title: CDN
bbs.config.cdn.token-comment: Token required for uploading models (only administrator with a token can upload files to CDN)
bbs.config.cdn.tooltip: Options for HTTP-based CDN asset synchronization
bbs.config.cdn.url-comment: URL to the CDN that is responsible for synchronizing assets
bbs.config.chroma_sky.billboard-comment: Whenever terrain is disabled, and the value is greater than 0, then a billboard will be rendered X blocks away from the camera. Majority of shader packs drawing their own sky, so this is a workaround for that
bbs.config.chroma_sky.enabled-comment: Enables or disables chroma sky, a mechanism that turns the sky in a solid color
bbs.config.chroma_sky.terrain-comment: Whether terrain is rendering when chroma sky is enabled
bbs.config.chroma_sky.title: Chroma sky
bbs.config.camera.angle_speed-comment: Angle flight speed when rotating the camera around
bbs.config.performance.frustum_culling-c: Skips rendering replays that are far outside the camera's view (a generous 32-block margin around each). Anchored replays are never culled. Turn it off if an actor ever disappears at the edge of the screen
bbs.config.performance.profiler_overlay-: Shows per-frame milliseconds by subsystem and call counters of the film editor's hot paths (pose evaluations, stencil passes, UI draw calls) in the corner of the preview
bbs.config.viewport.clip_preview-comment: When enabled, you can see currently selected clip in the keyframe timeline
bbs.config.viewport.crosshair-comment: Shows a crosshair in the middle of the camera editor's screen
bbs.config.timeline.duration-comment: What is default duration of a camera clip (in ticks)
bbs.config.viewport.guides_color-comment: Color that will be used for rule of thirds and center lines (including transparency)
bbs.config.timeline.horizontal_clip_edit: Determines whether clip editor's elements will be organized vertically or horizontally
bbs.config.camera.horizontal_flight-comm: When enabled, the pitch of the camera won't affect the movement making the WASD movement cardinal (XZ plane)
bbs.config.camera.orbit_movement_require: Movement in orbit camera only in flight
When enabled, WASD does nothing in the orbit camera until flight is turned on, where it flies the camera freely. When disabled, WASD also pans the orbit itself without entering flight.
bbs.config.camera.orbit_center_marker-co: Shows a debug marker at the point the orbit camera currently rotates around.
bbs.config.camera.orbit_gizmo-comment: Shows an interactive navigation ball in the bottom left corner of the preview in the orbit camera mode. Drag it to rotate the orbit, click an axis ball to align the camera with that axis.
bbs.config.camera.orbit_gizmo_scale-comm: Size multiplier of the navigation ball in the preview's corner.
bbs.config.camera.orbit_axis_ortho-comme: When enabled, clicking an axis ball also switches the camera to an orthographic projection, so the view reads as a blueprint, and orbiting away from the axis brings the perspective back. A projection you toggled by hand is never touched.
bbs.config.viewport.motion_path-comment: Draws the selected recording's movement as a curve in the scene, with a marker on every position keyframe.
bbs.config.viewport.ik_debug-comment: The look of the IK debug overlay — configured through the debug toggle's gear in the IK panel.
bbs.config.viewport.physics_debug-commen: The look of the physics debug overlay — configured through the debug toggle's gear in the physics panel.
bbs.config.camera.orbit_teleport_on_swit: Teleport orbit to recording on switch
When enabled, switching to another recording moves the orbit camera's center onto it. When disabled, the orbit keeps its current center.
bbs.config.camera.camera_smoothness-comm: How smoothly the editor camera follows your input — rotation, movement, zoom, panning and FOV. 0 is instant; higher values make camera control glide. Applies to flight and orbit camera control.
bbs.config.camera.player_follows_camera-: When enabled, your player is teleported each tick to match the film camera position and view direction.
bbs.config.timeline.anchor_keep_transfor: When enabled, changing what an anchor hangs off compensates its transform so the form stays where it was instead of jumping into the new target's frame. Measured at the frame under the playhead, so an animated anchor transform is only exact there. Toggled from the anchor keyframe editor itself.
bbs.config.timeline.auto_keyframe-commen: When enabled, changing any value in the film editor keys it at the playhead instead of rewriting the keyframe you have selected. If the track has no keyframe at the playhead yet, one is made from the value the track already reads there, so keying never moves anything by itself. Toggled from the context menu of the record icon over the film preview.
bbs.config.timeline.jump-comment: By how many ticks do jump keybinds move the timeline's cursor (up and down arrow keybinds)
bbs.config.workspace.keep_frame_on_exit-: When you leave BBS from the film editor, the tick that was on screen stays rendered in the world instead of disappearing. The "Freeze when paused" toggle keeps ruling it: off, the forms go on idling on that tick. It is taken down when you open the film editor again. Replays marked as actors still leave with the editor, since those are real entities driven by the server.
bbs.config.timeline.loop-comment: Loops playback of currently selected clip or looping region (you can use [ and ] keys to select the region, or Alt + click drag on the timeline)
bbs.config.workspace.minutes_backup-comm: The data will be saved every 10 minutes instead of every hour
bbs.config.viewport.preview_size_mode-co: Select how film preview resolution is calculated.
bbs.config.viewport.preview_custom_width: Custom preview render width, used when preview size mode is set to Custom.
bbs.config.viewport.preview_custom_heigh: Custom preview render height, used when preview size mode is set to Custom.
bbs.config.viewport.preview_resolution_s: Multiplier for automatic preview mode (1 = same as block size, 1.5 = sharper, higher = less pixelation, more GPU load)
bbs.config.viewport.preview_selection_hu: Shows the selected recording's name, what the gizmo is on and the form's thumbnail in the top right corner of the preview
bbs.config.viewport.preview_icons_auto_h: When enabled, the icon bar at the bottom of the preview stays hidden and only appears while the mouse is over the preview
bbs.config.workspace.periodic_save-comme: Number of seconds that triggers automatic save repeatedly. To disable periodic saving, set the option to 0
bbs.config.workspace.resizable_panels-co: When enabled, you can resize panels in the film and particle editors by dragging their borders. Disable it to prevent accidental resizing
bbs.config.workspace.title: Workspace
bbs.config.timeline.rewind-comment: Whether the playback should be rewound to beginning upon finishing playing the film
bbs.config.viewport.title: Viewport
bbs.config.viewport.tooltip: Guides, preview size and overlays drawn over the preview
bbs.config.timeline.seconds-comment: When enabled, this option will use seconds, instead of ticks, for displaying and editing in camera editor
bbs.config.timeline.timeline_grid-commen: When enabled, the timeline ruler's lines are extended over the tracks at full height as a vertical grid
bbs.config.timeline.keyframe_default_int: Interpolation given to a keyframe you create by hand in an empty spot, where linear was used before. Keyframes created next to existing ones still inherit their neighbour's interpolation, as before. Recorded and baked keyframes are not affected.
bbs.config.timeline.snap_to_film_markers: When enabled, dragging a clip snaps it to the film's markers
bbs.config.timeline.snap_to_markers-comm: When enabled, clip snapping will snap to tick markers
bbs.config.timeline.stop_playback_on_scr: When enabled, dragging the cursor on a timeline stops the playback of the film
bbs.config.timeline.restart_on_seek-comm: When enabled, restarting the actions (Alt + R by default) happens automatically every time you scrub the cursor on the timeline. It is skipped during playback, recording, character control and video export
bbs.config.timeline.title: Timeline
bbs.config.timeline.tooltip: Playback, keyframe defaults and the look of the timeline
bbs.config.camera.speed-comment: Flight speed when moving the camera around
bbs.config.camera.title: Camera
bbs.config.camera.tooltip: Flight and orbit controls of the editor camera
bbs.config.misc.entity_selectors_whiteli: A list of entity's NBT keys that are whitelisted to be compared when entity's NBT was changed to reflect changes
bbs.config.model_blocks.click-comment: Whether model blocks can be picked in the model block panel editor by clicking on them
bbs.config.model_blocks.render_all-comme: Whether all model blocks should be rendered
bbs.config.model_blocks.title: Model blocks
bbs.config.performance.multiskin_multith: Allows you to toggle multi-threaded processing of multi-skins, which should fix the lag at cost of longer processing
bbs.config.recording.camera_preview-comm: Allows to toggle rendering of camera boundaries in the film editor (when the camera mode isn't "Camera")
bbs.config.recording.overlays-comment: Whether recording overlays will be displayed (counter, current tick and camera preview will be displayed)
bbs.config.recording.pose_transform_over: How many additional pose and transform tracks forms will have (relog into the world to refresh the number of overlays)
bbs.config.recording.swipe_damage-commen: When swipe action clip gets recorded, insert also an automatic attack action clip
bbs.config.recording.teleport-comment: When recording is started with the "Outside" button in the film editor, teleport the player to where the replay stands at that tick. The record key doesn't teleport: it starts the take where you're standing (replays without any position keyframes are left alone either way)
bbs.config.recording.title: Recording
bbs.config.recording.tooltip: Here is everything related to player recording system
bbs.config.scrollbars.sensitivity-commen: Allows you to change the factor of how much faster or slower mouse wheel scrolling
bbs.config.scrollbars.sensitivity_horizo: Allows you to change the factor of how much faster or slower mouse wheel scrolling horizontally
bbs.config.scrollbars.smoothness-comment: Allows you to toggle between smooth and immediate scrolling
bbs.config.scrollbars.disable_smoothness: Disables scroll smoothing in the main keyframe and clip editor panels, even when global scrolling smoothness is enabled
bbs.config.scrollbars.title: Scrollbars
bbs.config.scrollbars.tooltip: Background options like color and texture to be used
bbs.config.scrollbars.width-comment: Allows you to setup the thickness (width of scrollbars)
bbs.config.performance.translucency_queu: When enabled, semi-transparent parts of forms are collected and drawn last, sorted far to near, so they blend over what is behind them instead of hiding it. Turn it off to draw every form in one immediate pass — the way it worked before this mechanism, and the way it already works under shaderpacks
bbs.config.misc.title: Misc
bbs.config.misc.tooltip: Features that own a single option each
bbs.config.title: BBS
bbs.config.tutorials.cursor-comment: Enables rendering of the mouse cursor. It's very useful for tutorials when they're recorded with BBS' video recorder and the cursor isn't visible
bbs.config.tutorials.keystrokes-comment: Enables rendering of the keystrokes. It's very useful for tutorials when to show which keys are being pressed
bbs.config.tutorials.keystrokes_offset-c: Allows to configure how many pixels away from the corner the keystroke line would be drawn
bbs.config.tutorials.keystrokes_position: Allows to change the corner of the keystroke line
bbs.config.tutorials.mouse_buttons-comme: Enables rendering of the mouse button presses and mouse wheel scrolling
bbs.config.tutorials.title: Tutorials options
bbs.config.tutorials.tooltip: This category provides options which are useful for making tutorial videos
bbs.config.video.encoder_path-comment: To record a video, you need to specify here a path to ffmpeg's binary (to ffmpeg or ffmpeg.exe file, depending on OS)
bbs.config.video.log-comment: If disabled, it will not generate the log in the video export folder (instead it will go into BBS mod's settings/video.log)
bbs.config.video.world_export_resize_win: Change window size when exporting from world
When enabled, exporting from world with F4/F6 temporarily changes Minecraft window size to export resolution and restores the size after stopping export.
bbs.config.video.title: Video recording
bbs.config.video.tooltip: This category provides options for recording video in the film editor
bbs.config.video.width-comment: Width of the exported video in pixels. Right click for resolution presets.
bbs.config.video.height-comment: Height of the exported video in pixels.
bbs.config.video.frame_rate-comment: How many frames per second the exported video will have.
bbs.config.video.limit_frame_rate-commen: When enabled, recording is throttled so it never renders faster than the frame rate above in real time. Use it on powerful machines where recording otherwise runs too fast (e.g. when capturing live or with audio).
bbs.config.video.export_path-comment: Folder where exported videos will be saved. If empty, the default export folder is used.
bbs.config.video.filename_format-comment:
File name template for the exported video. Words in curly braces are substituted:
{name} - film name,
{date} - date,
{time} - time,
{datetime} - date and time,
{width} - width,
{height} - height,
{fps} - fps,
{duration} - length in seconds
bbs.config.video.audio-comment: This option exports audio clips as audio and then pieces it together with the recorded video (Minecraft sounds are controlled by the separate option below)
bbs.config.video.minecraft_sounds-commen: When enabled, Minecraft sounds heard during the recording (footsteps, digging, mobs, weather, etc.) are captured and mixed into the exported video's audio track. Background music and UI clicks are ignored. The master volume doesn't affect the capture (rendering muted is fine), but sound categories set to 0% in Minecraft's sound settings are not captured.
bbs.config.video.mute_audio_while_render: When enabled, BBS audio clips in the film are silent on the speakers while a video export is recording (the exported audio track is unchanged if Export audio is enabled).
bbs.config.video.motion_blur-comment: The bigger the number, the better quality of motion blur, but also the longer it will take to record
bbs.config.video.held_frames-comment: Increase if you need to stabilize picture of accumulative shaders (like RT or PT)
bbs.config.video.delay-comment: Delay before export starts (seconds). Useful to let replays/entities fully settle on the first tick.
bbs.config.video.open_folder_after_expor: When enabled, the folder containing the exported video will open in the system file manager after the render completes.
bbs.config.video.play_sound_after_export: When enabled, a sound is played when the render completes. When disabled, no sound is played.
bbs.config.video.arguments-comment: FFmpeg arguments used to encode the video. Placeholders: %WIDTH%, %HEIGHT%, %FPS%, %FILTERS%, %NAME%.
bbs.config.video.arguments_audio-comment: FFmpeg arguments used when audio export is enabled. Adds the %AUDIO_TRACK% placeholder.
bbs.config.video.arguments_mux-comment: FFmpeg arguments used to merge the audio track into the already recorded video when Minecraft sounds export is enabled. Placeholders: %VIDEO% (recorded video), %AUDIO_TRACK% (audio file), %NAME% (output name without extension).
bbs.ui.audio_editor.title: Audio editor
bbs.ui.camera.clips.bbs:subtitle: Subtitle
bbs.ui.camera.editor.keys.clips.select_t: Select all clips on current track
Select to the left on current track
Select to the right on current track
bbs.ui.camera.editor.keys.clips.title: Clips
bbs.ui.camera.editor.keys.editor.title: Camera editor
bbs.ui.camera.editor.keys.looping.title: Looping
bbs.ui.camera.editor.keys.modes.title: Modes
bbs.ui.camera.panels.audio.extend_durati: Extend this clip's duration to the duration of the audio
bbs.ui.camera.panels.context.look_block: Get center block coordinates at cursor
bbs.ui.camera.panels.copy_entity_tooltip: Copy entity's head orientation, exactly like GoPros
bbs.ui.camera.panels.deterministic_toolt: When enabled, deterministic algorithm would be used to calculate reproducible smoothed out camera movement.
bbs.ui.camera.panels.dolly.distance: Distance which determines for how many blocks will dolly travel in given direction during given duration
bbs.ui.camera.panels.dolly.pitch: Vertical direction (pitch, measured in degrees) in which dolly will travel
bbs.ui.camera.panels.dolly.reverse: Switch places beginning end, basically reverse it
bbs.ui.camera.panels.dolly.title: Dolly
bbs.ui.camera.panels.dolly.yaw: Horizontal direction (yaw, measured in degrees) in which dolly will travel
bbs.ui.camera.panels.duration: Clip's duration (measured in ticks, 20 ticks = ~1 second), the number determines for how long the clip will be applied
bbs.ui.camera.panels.envelopes.title: Envelope
bbs.ui.camera.panels.factor_tooltip: Linear factor (between 0 and 1), the smaller the value, the more it will smooth out
bbs.ui.camera.panels.forward_tooltip: This option orients the camera toward the vector of motion, exactly like a roller coaster
bbs.ui.camera.panels.layer: Clip's layer, the number determines the order in which camera's clip behavior will be applied, the higher the number, the later it will be applied
bbs.ui.camera.panels.rate_tooltip: Rate (in frames) at which data should smoothed out per second, the the higher the number, the more intensive calculations are. Only used when deterministic is enabled!
bbs.ui.camera.panels.relative_tooltip: Apply relative animation of the clip or camera profile
bbs.ui.camera.panels.subtitle.font_size: Font size. It only decides how big the text is laid out - sharpness is picked automatically
bbs.ui.camera.panels.subtitle.line_heigh: Line height. 0 takes the font's own spacing
bbs.ui.camera.panels.placement.title: Placement
bbs.ui.camera.panels.placement.scale-shi: Both scales change together — hold Shift to change this axis alone
bbs.ui.camera.panels.target-tooltip: This clip will target specific actor in the film
bbs.ui.camera.panels.tick: Clip's tick (measured in ticks, 20 ticks = ~1 second), the number determines how far is this clip into the camera work
bbs.ui.camera.panels.title: Title
bbs.ui.camera.panels.title_tooltip: Display name which will be displayed in the timeline
bbs.ui.camera.timeline.cant_fit-notifica: Can't fit a clip right there...
bbs.ui.camera.timeline.context.add_on_to: Add clip on top of selected...
bbs.ui.camera.timeline.context.record_mi: Type in the filename for the recorded audio track:
Hold LMB to finish, RMB to cancel
bbs.ui.camera.timeline.incompatible_past: Pasted data couldn't be read... perhaps it's intended for another type of clip editor?
bbs.ui.camera.tooltips.pick_export_folde: Pick videos folder... (right click to open it)
bbs.ui.color.eyedropper: Pick a color from the screen
bbs.ui.color.revert: Back to the color you started with

bbs.ui.transforms.mirror_edit:
Mirror edit

When enabled, editing a bone also mirrors the change onto its opposite-side (left/right) counterpart in real time — even when the counterpart isn't selected — so a symmetric pose stays symmetric without having to select both.
bbs.ui.transforms.alternate_invert:
Alternate invert

With several bones selected, every second one (2nd, 4th, ...) gets its rotation inverted. E.g. rotate the 1st bone +90° on X and the 2nd rotates -90°. Works on the manual selection, in selection order.

Rotation storage (click to toggle Euler / Quaternion).

Quaternion is gimbal-free; Euler keeps >360° spins and per-component curves.
